turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Describe a frontend feature you worked on. How did data move from a user action to the interface, and what did you implement?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I wrote the validation helper and the form-state handling for the bulk-edit drawer myself. Changing a field updated the draft object, and Submit sent that object to the existing endpoint. I am referring to the version in the last release.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Walk me through a user-facing defect you investigated. What did you observe, and how did you decide what was causing it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I investigated why validation errors disappeared. In the network panel I saw the endpoint return an errors array while the UI handler read an error string. I compared that payload with the handler and identified a shape mismatch. I have no production monitoring result after the change.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How did you check the change and decide it was ready for release?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I wrote component tests for an empty selection, a successful response and an errors-array response. The error test asserted that each returned message stayed visible. The requests were mocked, so these checks did not establish backend compatibility.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What accessibility work or checks did you perform on this interface?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I added visible text labels to two form controls. I did not inspect their programmatic association or try keyboard or assistive-technology behavior.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Looking back, what were the limits of your ownership or evidence, and what would you investigate or ask for help with next?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: To clarify the same last-release drawer: another engineer wrote both the validation helper and the form-state handling. I did not edit either of those parts. I wrote the component tests. I cannot reconcile that with my earlier ownership description without checking the change history.
